name: Changbai Mountain Tourism Co., Ltd.
summary: Changbai Mountain Tourism Co., Ltd. operates in the tourism industry in China. The company engages in tourist passenger transportation, hot spring development, hotel and travel agency management, scenic spot management, transportation operation, vacation services, business management consulting and operation, product planning and marketing, and other activities. Changbai Mountain Tourism Co., Ltd. is based in Changbai, China. The company operates as a subsidiary of Jilin Changbai Mountain Development and Construction (Group) Co.,Ltd.
